messages.subject: Another question about scheduling
parts:
Say you have a bank with a resource ‘teller'  that has a schedule from 9 to 5. It is 5pm but the teller is still ‘seized’ by a customer. Will the teller be automatically released by 5pm or will the resource stay seized until ‘timeout’?
Regards,

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Another question about scheduling
parts:
El sáb., 7 jul. 2018 a las 4:11, Cwei (<slende...@gmail.com>) escribió:
>
>
> Say you have a bank with a resource ‘teller' that has a schedule from 9 to 5. It is 5pm but the teller is still ‘seized’ by a customer. Will the teller be automatically released by 5pm or will the resource stay seized until ‘timeout’?

It depends.

- If preemptive=FALSE, it will stay.
- If preemptive=TRUE, it will be dropped from the server, so if the
queue_size changes to 0 and the resource has queue_size_strict=TRUE
defined, then the customer will be rejected.

> Regards,
>

Iñaki
